svg.aria-label: Landora data flow. Top lane: property data flows in from six sources ranked by authority, through rules, ingest, enrichment, moderation and an AI grounding check, into one canonical store where every fact keeps its source, and out to buyer, agent and admin screens. Bottom lane: buyer personal data, where analytics, concierge memory and sharing with agents each need purpose-specific consent, and FHB answers and search text are not stored.
